title: RARA: Robust Policy Fine-Tuning through Retrieval-Anchored Representation Alignment for Robotic Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.13578v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pre-trained robot policies, such as Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, provide a strong foundation for generalist robotic manipulation, but adapting them to new tasks with only a few demonstrations remains challenging. Directly fine-tuning a pre-trained policy often achieves strong in-distribution performance, yet it can distort the representations learned during pre-training and weaken the model's generalization ability under out-of-distribution shifts. We propose Retrieval-Anchored Representation Alignment (RARA), a two-stage adaptation method, to address this issue. First, RARA retrieves representation features from pretraining with similar task intent and motion, and aligns the policy's representations of the target demonstrations with the pre-trained representations of the retrieved demonstrations. translated_title: RARA：通过检索锚定表示对齐实现机器人操作的鲁棒策略微调
translated_abstract: 预训练的机器人策略（如视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型）为通用机器人操作提供了坚实的基础，但仅凭少量演示将它们适应到新任务仍然具有挑战性。直接微调预训练策略通常能在分布内取得出色的性能，但这可能会扭曲预训练期间学到的表示，并削弱模型在分布外偏移下的泛化能力。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了检索锚定表示对齐，这是一种两阶段适应方法。首先，RARA从预训练中检索具有相似任务意图和运动的表示特征，并将策略对目标演示的表示与检索到的演示的预训练表示进行对齐。其次，RARA在目标演示上对策略进行微调，同时限制其对检索到的演示的表示发生偏移的程度……
tldr: 本文提出RARA，一种两阶段微调方法，通过检索预训练中任务意图和运动相似的表示特征并对齐目标演示的表示，在少量演示适应新任务的同时保护预训练表示不被扭曲，从而保持模型在分布外偏移下的鲁棒泛化能力。
en_tdlr: RARA is a two-stage fine-tuning method that anchors adaptation by aligning target demonstration representations with retrieved pretraining features, preserving pre-trained knowledge and enabling robust out-of-distribution generalization when adapting robot policies to new tasks with few demonstrations.
